text.p: Following is the election diary for Wednesday April 17:
Prime Minister John Major, Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind and Conservative Party chairman Brian Mawhinney present daily news briefing at 0915 am (0815 GMT)
Major then sets off on campaign trail to northwest England.

Labour Party leader Tony Blair, Shadow Chancellor Gordon Brown, Shadow Health Secretary Chris Smith and Shadow Health Minister Tessa Jowell present daily news briefing at 0830 am (0730 GMT). Blair then sets off on campaign trail and is expected to make health his theme for the day.
Labour's youth spokesperson Mo Mowlam and campaign manager Peter Mandelson launch video intended to encourage young people to vote.
Labour's deputy leader John Prescott visits Birmingham, Stourbridge and Corby. -- London newsroom +4471 542 7950
